LimitParam.name: limit
LimitParam.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

TagParam.name: tag
TagParam.description: Filter by tag slug. Alias of `tag_slug`.

AscendingParam.name: ascending
AscendingParam.description: Set to true for ascending order.

CreatorParam.name: creator
CreatorParam.description: Optional creator filter. Use a creator wallet address or a site identifier to scope results to markets available on that site.

MarketIdPathParam.name: id
MarketIdPathParam.description: Numeric market id or condition id.

EventIdParam.name: event_id
EventIdParam.description: Filter markets by numeric event id.

EventSlugParam.name: event_slug
EventSlugParam.description: Filter markets by event slug. Alias: `eventSlug`.

ConditionIdParam.name: conditionId
ConditionIdParam.description: Filter markets by condition id. Alias: `condition_id`.

MirrorParam.name: mirror
MirrorParam.description: Filter by Polymarket origin. `true` returns only mirror markets; `false` returns only markets without a Polymarket mirror.

LimitPerTypeParam.name: limit_per_type
LimitPerTypeParam.description: Maximum number of rows to return per result type.

SearchTagsParam.name: search_tags
SearchTagsParam.description: Set to true to include tag matches.

SearchProfilesParam.name: search_profiles
SearchProfilesParam.description: Accepted for Gamma compatibility, but profile search results are not returned by this service.

SlugNotFoundResponse.description: The resource slug was not found.

mirrorConditionId.description: Polymarket condition identifier paired with `conditionId`. Omitted when the market is not a Polymarket mirror or the value is unavailable.

mirrorClobTokenIds.description: JSON-encoded array of Polymarket token identifiers. Each item at index `i` is paired with `clobTokenIds[i]`. Omitted when the market is not a Polymarket mirror or a complete positional token mapping is unavailable.
